name: Da'nor
description: Da'nor, also known as Planet X, was a planet in the Delantine system, near Romm. It orbited three stars and thus went through four seasonal changes each day. Stuart Zissu, C-3PO, 4B-X, and R2-D2 crashed on the planet in Escape pod 4. They were rescued from the planet by Granit. From Da'nor, Stuart was ordered to go to Romm. The language N'or was spoken on the planet. It was homeworld to large predatory birds and flying lizards.
